description: 一款开源、基于昔涟开发的桌面 AI 智能体/An open-source desktop AI agent based on Cyrene.
summary: An open-source desktop AI agent built around Cyrene’s persona and powered by the self-developed Cyrene_Harness framework. It combines immersive character chat with practical Agent capabilities for daily tasks, coding assistance, learning, and tools like music and weather.
